title: Norwegian Cheese Casserole
description: A gooey, cheesy casserole with a Norwegian twist. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Quick Cheese
ingredients.notes: Shredded or sliced, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: Gooey Cheese
ingredients.notes: For an extra gooey top layer

ingredients.name: Casserole
ingredients.notes: A pre-made casserole to simplify things

instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter.
Open the casserole package and spread it evenly in the prepared dish.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the casserole.
Dot the top with Norwegian cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and top with gooey cheese.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
